newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee eases on state firm's dollar purchases.
newsitem.headline: India rupee eases on state firm's dollar purchases.

text.p: The Indian rupee eased to 35.82/83 in late morning trade on Thursday because of unexpected dollar demand from a state-run firm, dealers said.
The rupee opened steady at 35.80/81 on Thursday.
"Banks in Bombay and Delhi are buying (dollars) for this firm," a dealer at a leading Bombay bank said.
The demand brightened the outlook for the dollar in the wake of Reserve Bank of India's large intervention on Wednesday.
Forward dollar premiums spurted, tracking the sentiment in the spot market, dealers said.
